comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace non-existent orchestrator CLI verify commands**

This verify list invokes `python -m dopemux.cli orchestrator ...`, but the current CLI does not expose an `orchestrator` top-level command (running `python -m dopemux.cli --help` shows no such command), so these checks fail immediately with `No such command 'orchestrator'`. Because this packet is a dependency for later DMX-ORCH follow-ups and the same pattern is repeated there, the plan’s required validation path is not executable as written.

comments.body: AGENTS.md requires proof to include a commit SHA and PR URL (or an explicit blocker). These PLAN_ONLY proof bundles currently set commit_sha/pr_url to null without a blocker that explains the missing values, which makes the bundle non-auditable once it’s detached from the PR context (same pattern appears across the other PLAN_ONLY proofs added in this PR).

comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require proof artifact lists to be non-empty**

When `manifest.generated_artifacts` or `authoritative_artifacts` is `[]`, this helper returns true because `all([])` is true, so the checks that are supposed to enforce generated/authoritative artifacts do not fire. That lets artifact-free proof bundles validate as `PASS`, which weakens the proof gate for READY_FOR_REVIEW/VERIFIED packets.

comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Persist progress receipts only after ConPort accepts them**

If the ConPort HTTP request fails or times out, this local journal write has already appended the progress/decision entry, and the TUI context panel reads this same `progress_log.json` as recorded progress. In that failure scenario the local receipt claims progress that the canonical ConPort write never accepted, so move the journal write after the successful `raise_for_status()` or mark it explicitly as a failed attempt.

comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject reused idempotency keys for different transitions**

When the same `idempotency_key` is accidentally reused for a different project/workflow/transition, this lookup only keys on the idempotency key and later returns any completed cached response without comparing the stored `project_id`, `workflow_id`, or `transition_name`. That can silently skip the new transition and return an unrelated prior result; the claim path should fetch and validate those fields before treating the row as the same operation.
